  KEY `fk_asset_responsible_employee` (`responsible_employee_id`),
  KEY `fk_asset_department_employee` (`department_responsible_employee_id`),
  KEY `fk_asset_parameter` (`parameter_version_id`),

  KEY `fk_asset_source` (`source_asset_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_current_location` FOREIGN KEY (`current_location_id`) REFERENCES `fams_location` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_department_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`department_responsible_employee_id`) REFERENCES `fams_employee` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_manufacturer` FOREIGN KEY (`manufacturer_id`) REFERENCES `fams_manufacturer` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_owning_organization` FOREIGN KEY (`owning_organization_id`) REFERENCES `fams_organization` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_parameter` FOREIGN KEY (`parameter_version_id`) REFERENCES `fams_business_parameter_version` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_planned_location` FOREIGN KEY (`planned_inbound_location_id`) REFERENCES `fams_location` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_planned_warehouse` FOREIGN KEY (`planned_inbound_warehouse_id`) REFERENCES `fams_warehouse` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_responsible_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`responsible_employee_id`) REFERENCES `fams_employee` (`id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_asset_using_organization` FOREIGN KEY (`using_organization_id`) REFERENCES `fams_organization` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_custody` CHECK ((((`custody_type` is null) and (`storage_warehouse_id` is null) and (`current_location_id` is null) and (`using_organization_id` is null) and (`responsible_employee_id` is null) and (`department_responsible_employee_id` is null)) or ((`custody_type` = _utf8mb4'STORAGE') and (`storage_warehouse_id` is not null) and (`current_location_id` is not null) and (`using_organization_id` is null) and (`responsible_employee_id` is null) and (`department_responsible_employee_id` is null)) or ((`custody_type` = _utf8mb4'PERSONAL') and (`storage_warehouse_id` is null) and (`current_location_id` is not null) and (`using_organization_id` is not null) and (`responsible_employee_id` is not null) and (`department_responsible_employee_id` is null)) or ((`custody_type` = _utf8mb4'SHARED') and (`storage_warehouse_id` is null) and (`current_location_id` is not null) and (`using_organization_id` is not null) and (`responsible_employee_id` is null) and (`department_responsible_employee_id` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_exception` CHECK ((`exception_status` in (_utf8mb4'NORMAL',_utf8mb4'SEARCHING',_utf8mb4'LOST'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_lifecycle` CHECK ((`lifecycle_status` in (_utf8mb4'WAITING_INBOUND',_utf8mb4'IN_STOCK',_utf8mb4'IN_USE',_utf8mb4'BORROWED',_utf8mb4'UNDER_REPAIR',_utf8mb4'FACTORY_REPAIR',_utf8mb4'PENDING_SCRAP',_utf8mb4'SCRAPPED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_planned_target` CHECK (((`planned_inbound_location_id` is null) or (`planned_inbound_warehouse_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_pre_inbound_custody` CHECK (((`card_stage` not in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'PENDING_INBOUND',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED')) or (`custody_type` is null))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_stage` CHECK ((`card_stage` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'PENDING_INBOUND',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_asset_version` CHECK ((`version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
